_about: TEST-31: golden reply bytes of the dispatcher, one case per resource kind or outcome.
Each case is a sequence of steps against a fresh server; a step is a request, its direct reply and any
events the handler queued while answering it (e.g. the deferred reply to an earlier step).
`request`/`reply`/an `events` entry are hex, or "?" until `just dispatch-golden-update` fills them in.
Requests are built in src/requests.rs, replies and events come from running both the sync and the async
server (src/server.rs, src/async_server.rs), which must agree. See docs/serdes/conformance.md for the
pattern this follows, and tests/dispatch.rs for the test and the frozen golden bytes guard (TEST-24-style,

cases.name: call.no_args
cases.note: The smallest Call: no arguments, no return value.

cases.name: call.with_args
cases.note: Call with arguments and a return value.

cases.name: call.absent
cases.note: The request is fine, there is no handler: Unimplemented.

cases.name: multi.deferred_then_answer
cases.note: deferred() answers nothing directly; answer_deferred() answers itself and queues the deferred reply as an event.

cases.name: property.write_user_error
cases.note: Setting `guarded` above 100 fails with the user error GuardedError::TooBig.

cases.name: const.read
cases.note: A Rust const, read with a plain Read like a property.

cases.name: sink.write
cases.note: A plain (non-credit) sink takes a plain Write, answered like a property write.

cases.name: array.call
cases.note: A Call through an index chain into channel[].

cases.name: array.bad_index
cases.note: channel[99] is out of range: BadIndex.

cases.name: global.full_read_name
cases.note: ww_user_info::UserInfo reached by GlobalFull.

cases.name: global.compact_write_name
cases.note: ww_user_info::UserInfo (ww_global id 12) reached by GlobalCompact.

cases.name: global.compact_read_const
cases.note: UserInfo::CAPABILITIES, a const, read on a GlobalCompact path.

cases.name: global.missing_trait
cases.note: Channel sits under channel[], a resource array: it can't be reached by a global path (PathKind::GlobalFull's own doc), so this is TraitNotFound.

cases.name: global.full_incompatible_version
cases.note: UserInfo by GlobalFull with another major version of ww_user_info: the trait's hash matches (SRV-53), its version doesn't, so this is TraitNotFound.

cases.name: error.bad_path
cases.note: An id past the root's items.

cases.name: error.too_deep_path
cases.note: no_args is a leaf: a trailing id past it is unused, not an error, and the call still succeeds.

cases.name: error.wrong_kind_call_on_property
cases.note: Call on a property's path: OperationNotSupported.

cases.name: error.wrong_kind_write_on_const
cases.note: Write on a const's path: OperationNotSupported.

cases.name: error.seq_zero_read_property
cases.note: seq 0 suppresses the reply for a Read too, same as a Call: the direct reply is empty.

cases.name: error.seq_zero_call_no_reply
cases.note: seq 0 on an ordinary Call means no answer is expected: the direct reply is empty.

cases.name: multi.multi_call
cases.note: MultiCall of channel[].pulse over indices 0 and 1 (multi_req = true).

cases.name: multi.multi_read
cases.note: MultiRead of channel[].level over indices 0 and 1 (multi_req = true).
